checks.name: utf8_offsets
checks.code:
from event_log import EventLog
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d)/'events';log=EventLog(p);log.append({'name':'雪'});second=log.append({'id':2});assert log.rebuild_index()==[0,second] and second==len(p.read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)[0])

checks.name: partial_tail_hidden
checks.code:
from event_log import EventLog
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d)/'events';log=EventLog(p);log.append({'id':1});with_tail=p.read_bytes()+b'{\"id\":2';p.write_bytes(with_tail);assert log.read_all()==[{'id':1}] and log.rebuild_index()==[0]

checks.name: append_rejects_partial_tail
checks.code:
from event_log import EventLog
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d)/'events';p.write_bytes(b'{\"id\":1');log=EventLog(p)
 try:log.append({'id':2})
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('append over partial')
 assert p.read_bytes()==b'{\"id\":1'
